slides.needs: tired boxer leaning on ropes, from behind
slides.text: Here's exactly why your hands drop in later rounds...
Your shoulders can't hold a guard for 3 minutes. Train it: hold your guard for full rounds.
Your arms are tense. Tense arms burn out your shoulders fast.
Nobody punishes it in training. Have your partner tap your head every time it drops.

slides.needs: boxer exhausted on floor of gym
slides.text: You only drill defense when you're fresh. Do it at the end of the session, tired.
